task: Implement F004 Countdown/Prelaunch page: a public /prelaunch page with an LED DAYS/HOURS/MINUTES countdown built from the MoMorph design, plus a middleware gate that redirects all routes to it before SAA launch and unlocks to the homepage at zero.
acceptanceCriteria: Public /prelaunch page renders the LED countdown per Figma
Middleware redirects every route to /prelaunch before launch
After launch /prelaunch redirects to home and routing unlocks
On reaching zero the page redirects to /
blastRadius: Middleware runs on every non-excluded route, so the gate affects the whole app; the shared CountdownUnit extraction also touches the homepage hero countdown.
contracts: Event datetime via NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENT_DATETIME + DEFAULT_EVENT_DATETIME, resolved through resolveEventTarget/resolveEventTargetIso
On zero: client redirect to /; middleware redirects /prelaunch -> / after launch
